Explore thousands of titles, rare manuscripts, and digital resources. 14,300 Titles 23,096 Items 1,154 Members 24/7 Online Access Buddhist Studies Philosophy Social Sciences Pali & Sanskrit Law Sciences About the Library The Central Library of Lumbini Buddhist University serves as the intellectual and academic heart of the university, dedicated to preserving and advancing the rich heritage of Buddhist philosophy, culture, and scholarship. Our collection encompasses thousands of books, journals, theses, and rare manuscripts spanning Buddhist studies, philosophy, religion, Pali and Sanskrit literature, social sciences, humanities, law, and natural sciences. We are committed to fostering a culture of research, critical thinking, and lifelong learning, nurturing students, researchers, and faculty in their journey of knowledge and enlightenment.
